name: How long does it take to install landscape lighting?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install landscape lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of landscape lighting installation depends on the scope and complexity of the project. A small, straightforward installation for a front yard might be completed in one to two days. Larger projects involving extensive property coverage, multiple zones, and intricate designs, such as those for estates in Arcadia or San Marino, could take several days to a week or more. We aim to minimize disruption and complete the work efficiently while maintaining our high standards of quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by project size and complexity; small jobs may take 1-2 days, while larger projects can extend to a week or more.
